answer: Require each agent to post a bond locked on-chain before it can submit work, then slash that bond if a randomly sampled task audit finds fabricated results. A single operator can still create many identities, but each must tie up capital and accept the same measurable risk; splitting identities no longer makes dishonest work free. The bond is the wharf, audits the nebula of uncertainty, and honest contributors the oasis: the attacker pays in locked funds and forfeited stake.
